Before posting, check [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/anshuman2401/hermes-mobile/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for suspected vulnerabilities. Do not include credentials, private hosts or paths, session IDs, prompts, responses, or unredacted logs/screenshots. Use synthetic examples.

## What happened?

Describe the observed behavior and what you expected.

## How can we reproduce it?

List the smallest steps using synthetic data. State whether a compatible host, emulator, or device was involved without identifying a private endpoint.

## Environment and evidence

App version or commit, Android version, device/emulator model, and any sanitized error category or screenshot. Say if you could not reproduce it without private data.
